snippet.title: Ridiculous Glitching Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Are you ready to RAGE QUIT?

fast-paced-retro-glitch-arcade-action-flappy-competitive-local-mulitplayer-mayhem

Ridiculous Glitching is a game made for the #flappjam (and also a little for the #candyjam).
You can find WIN, OSX and Linux downloads here: http://firepunchd.itch.io/ridiculousglitching.
You can play directly in your browser here: http://bit.ly/glitching


Who will rank Nr.1 of the world?
